about: Reviewed by hand (docs/switch-builder.md §4.1). scripts/switch-library/build.mjs applies it through lib/select.mjs and logs every slug it leaves out in selection-log.json. items: Wikidata items listed under none of their store slugs although Wikidata types them as video games; kind not-a-game = apps, services and subscription launchers, kind adult = tagged eroge or erotic video game (P136) in Wikidata, kept out of a family store by default (to list one again, delete its entry and run build.mjs). slugs: store slugs left out for every item that holds them, so the item keeps another of its slugs. id = the library id (Nintendo US store slug) the entry was reviewed on, qid = the Wikidata item; tests/switch-library-data.test.ts checks both against the snapshot.
